ANNUAL PERAHARA OF BADULL KATARAGAMA DEVALAYA

IN accordance with the powers vested in me by Gazette Notifications No. 9902 of 10.09.1948, No. 10283 of 17.08.1951 and No. 14778 of 25.03.1955 published under Chapter 362 of the Pilgrimage Act, and under the powers conferred on Divisional Secretaries by Act No. 58 of 1992, and according to the constitution published in No. 1622 Gazette Notification of 02.10.2009 on Annual Perehara of Badulla Kataragama Devalaya, I Nihal Gunarathne, the Divisional Secretary of Badulla do hereby make the following orders in connection with the Annual Perehara of Badulla Katharagama Devalaya, 2018. 1. I, do hereby notice that, the Annual Perehara of Badulla Katharagana Devalaya shall begin with “Kap Situvima” on 31st of August 2019 and by having inner Perehara from 31st August 2019 to 04th September 2019 (5 days), by having Kumbal Perehara from 05th September 2019 to 09 th September 2019 (05 days), by having Randoli Perahera from 10th September to 14th September 2019 (5 days) by having water cutting ceremony in the morning on 15th September 2019 and end in the afternoon on 15th September 2019 after having returned to the Devalaya. 2. Route of the Perehara The Perahera shall start from Badull Katharagama Devalaya premises and proceed along Badulla lower Street, Passara Road (Muthiyangana Roundabout), Longden Road, Anagarika Dharmapala Mawatha, Cocowatte Road, Udayaraja Mawatha, King’s Street, Bazzar Street lower Street and back to Badulla Katharagama Devalaya. 3. Cooking and selling article of trade are prohibited in and around Badulla Katharagama Devalaya compound where the throne of the Devalaya located.

4. Private vehicles are prohibited to park in the main roads during the Perehara Season. All types of vehicles, including bicycles and carts are prohibited to enter the Devala area without a permit issued by me or the Nilame in-charge of the Devalaya. 5. The permanent buildings and the buildings currently being constructed along the Perahera route under a formal approval given by Badulla Municipal Council must conform to the instructions of the Health Department. At the end of the Perehara, after having dismantled the temporary sheds, the lessees shall dispose of all polythene and other garbage lying along the route of perehara and Devala premises as instructed by the Public Health Inspectors. 6. Construction of any temporary hut or building in and around the sacred area shall not be done without a permit obtained from me thereto. 7. No person shall construct any temporary hut or building of any form, or effect any extensions to any existing building on a street or on a land reserved for a street or in the sacred area without a permit obtained from me or from the Badulla Municipal Council. 8. Burning of crackers within the area is prohibited. 9. No person shall engage in selling tickets, flags or engage in any other task meant for collecting subscriptions, within the camping site indicated in clause No. 03 without the prior approval of an Authorized officer of Divisional Secretary. NIHAL GUNARATHNE, Divisional Secretary (Acting), Badulla. At Divisional Secretariat, Badulla, On 25th of July 2019.
